name: Travel and visa fee payments for groups from the same recruiter
description: Bulk payments for flights, visas and recruitment fees to a labour recruiter, sometimes debt-financed.
fp: Genuine recruitment agencies charge fees in some corridors.

UNODC, Global Report on Trafficking in Persons (biennial; specify edition e.g. 2024)
